layouts.description: Draft configuration: The national federation 2025 Circuito 2B plan (page 6) identifies the full southern finger, southeast curved outer return and smooth northeast corner. The angular northeast alternative and straight southeast shortcut are excluded. Independent public nodes supply the trace; the archive image only identifies the named configuration. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1094.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
